name: CTI Article Analysis
description: Fetches one reviewed CTI article at a time, validates and cleans it, then performs quota-controlled Gemini analysis.

parameters.query: SELECT claimed.article_id, claimed.canonical_url, claimed.title, claimed.source_name, claimed.content_selector, claimed.allowed_hosts, claimed.attempt, source.trust_score AS source_trust_score FROM cti.claim_analysis_jobs($1, $2, $3) AS claimed JOIN cti.sources AS source ON source.name = claimed.source_name;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Claim One Analysis Job').item.json.article_id, 'claimed_url_invalid', false, false, null] }}
={{ [$('Claim One Analysis Job').item.json.article_id, 'article_fetch_failed', false, false, null] }}
={{ [$('Claim One Analysis Job').item.json.article_id, 'content_extraction_failed', false, false, null] }}
={{ [$('Claim One Analysis Job').item.json.article_id, 'article_content_invalid', false, false, null] }}
={{ [$('Claim One Analysis Job').item.json.article_id, 'rule_triage_failed', false, false, null] }}
